title: Events, Forms, and User Input
summary: Respond to clicks, handle form submission without reloading, and read values from form controls.

sketchBlocks.title: addEventListener connects an event to a function
submit, preventDefault, and value work together
currentTarget gives the handler the control that fired its listener

quizDraft.title: Recognize correct behavior
quizDraft.prompt: Which statements about forms and events are true?
options: preventDefault can stop normal form navigation.
An input value can be read with .value.
A submit listener can run a handler.
currentTarget always means the whole document.
quizDraft.hint: More than one statement can be correct.

help.concept: This check separates the responsibilities introduced in the lesson.
help.hint_1: Keep only statements that match the actual JavaScript or browser behavior.
help.hint_2: Reject statements that assign the concept a different job.

quizDraft.title: Reveal a study tip
quizDraft.prompt: Problem: A study tip should appear only after the learner asks for it instead of being permanently visible. Task: When `#tip-button` is clicked, change `#tip` to `"Review for 10 minutes"`. Expected result: clicking the button reveals the study tip in the Preview.
quizDraft.hint: Put the page update inside a function registered for click.

help.concept: A click listener runs a handler later in response to user interaction.

help.hint_2: Pass the handler function without calling it.

quizDraft.title: Handle a nickname form
quizDraft.prompt: Problem: A nickname form should display what the learner entered without reloading the page and losing the interaction. Task: Handle `#nickname-form`, prevent the default submit, read `#nickname`, and show the value in `#nickname-output`. Expected result: submitting the form keeps the page in place and displays the entered nickname.
quizDraft.hint: Read the current value inside the submit handler.

help.concept: A submit handler can stop navigation and use the form's current data.
help.hint_1: The handler needs the event parameter.
help.hint_2: Call preventDefault before copying the input value into the output.
